subject: POC trial environment setup - hosted vs dedicated vs VPC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial environment setup - hosted vs dedicated vs VPC

Hi John / Jane,

Great speaking with you today — thanks for the time and context on Acme's search/chat assistant pilot. Per our call, I've sketched a proposed POC plan and a set of environment options so you can decide what fits your security and performance goals. Attached: POC_Success_Criteria.docx and RDW-POC-MAP.xlsx.

Summary of options (high level):
- Hosted (Redwood API): fastest to start, no infra changes on your side, limited to our hosted region controls. Great if you want to validate product fit quickly.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): predictable throughput, isolated GPU pool in our environment. Good middle ground for performance-sensitive evals without full network setup.
- VPC trial (Private deployment): customer-managed VPC peering or private link, full network isolation and KMS control. Best for regulated data, but adds networking/ops overhead and typically 2-4 week setup.

Success criteria (draft):
1) 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 512-token gen workload
2) End-to-end quality scores on our shared eval set: mean satisfaction >= 4.0/5
3) Embedding similarity recall >= 0.85 on sample dataset
4) Throughput target: sustained 10 qps with tails below 500ms

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm preferred environment option (hosted / dedicated / VPC)
2) Share technical contact for network/VPC and an expected start date
3) If VPC, confirm cloud provider & preferred region (us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1)

If you prefer, we can start on hosted immediately while parallel-ing work for a dedicated or VPC trial.

Thanks — I'll loop in Dev to cover network and infra specifics once you confirm environment preference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Hi Jane / John — happy to help. Quick summary of network requirements by option: 

Hosted (fastest):
- No peering required. Outbound calls to Redwood API endpoints (api.redwood.ai) over TLS 1.2+.
- Recommend allowlist of our egress IP ranges for stable traffic: 52.24.12.0/22, 34.210.0.0/16 (note: these are examples; will provide exact ranges).

Dedicated sandbox: 
- We can provision a dedicated GPU pool in our infra. No VPC peering required, but we will provision tenant-level isolation.
- If you want private connectivity, we can offer a private link with a one-time setup.

VPC trial / Private: 
- Requires VPC peering or PrivateLink and minimal routing config. We'll need: project ID, VPC CIDR ranges, desired region (we support us-west-2 and us-east-1 for pilots), and a set of allowed subnets.
- Certificate and KMS integration options available; need to sign an AUP for key management.

For the trial starting Jul 27, if you pick hosted we can issue API keys today. If you pick dedicated/VPC and want us to start provisioning, please share network contact (Jane) and the cloud project details.

Also: please confirm whether Acme requires a data residency restriction (we can pin region).

Regards,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
